description: Retrieve the raw, unprocessed datasecurity rules for a data model.

datamodel_name.description: Name (title) of the data model to retrieve raw datasecurity rules for.

datamodel_type.description: The data model's type (``"extract"`` or ``"live"``), if already known. When provided, the datasecurity endpoint is built directly from ``datamodel_name`` and this type, skipping the data model resolve call. When omitted, the data model is resolved by name first (matching ``get_datasecurity``).

examples.user_query: Retrieve the raw datasecurity rules for the 'Sales Data' extract model.
examples.notes: This retrieves the raw, unprocessed datasecurity rules for the 'Sales Data' data model of type 'extract'. Use this when you know the data model type and want to avoid resolving it by name.

description: Add multiple datasecurity rules to a LIVE datamodel.

datamodel_name.description: Title of the LIVE datamodel to update.

rules.description: Datasecurity rules to add. LIVE models ONLY. `live` and `fullname` are filled in automatically when omitted.

table.description: Table the rule applies to (case sensitive).

column.description: Column/dimension the rule applies to (case sensitive).

datatype.description: Column data type. Date dimensions cannot be secured.

members.description: Values the parties may see. Mutually exclusive with allMembers — supply one or the other.

allMembers.description: Apply to every value of the column. Must be null (not false) when not in use; when set, members is ignored.

exclusionary.description: true reverses the rule — the listed members are hidden instead of shown.

shares.description: Who the rule applies to. Must not be empty: a rule with no shares applies to nobody, and the LIVE API accepts it and then discards it.

partyId.description: OID of the user or group the rule applies to.

type.description: Party type. Sisense also supports a 'default' catch-all rule for parties with no explicit rule; that is not created through this call — Sisense adds one automatically alongside the first rule on a column.

examples.notes: This call adds two data security rules to the 'Sales_Live' datamodel, restricting access to specific regions and customer types.

examples.user_query: Can I add rules to limit access to the 'Finance_Live' datamodel for specific departments?
examples.notes: This call adds rules to the 'Finance_Live' datamodel to limit access to specific departments and exclude confidential transactions.

description: Add datasecurity rules to an EXTRACT (Elasticube) datamodel.

datamodel_name.description: Title of the EXTRACT datamodel to update.

datasecurity.description: Datasecurity rules to add. EXTRACT (Elasticube) models ONLY — this call refuses LIVE models. Adding a rule for a table/column that already has one for the same party UPDATES that rule rather than duplicating it.

table.description: Table the rule applies to (case sensitive).

column.description: Column/dimension the rule applies to (case sensitive).

datatype.description: Column data type. Date dimensions cannot be secured.

members.description: Values the parties may see. Mutually exclusive with allMembers — supply one or the other.

allMembers.description: Apply to every value of the column. Must be null (not false) when not in use; when set, members is ignored.

exclusionary.description: true reverses the rule — the listed members are hidden instead of shown.

shares.description: Who the rule applies to. Must not be empty: a rule with no shares applies to nobody, and the LIVE API accepts it and then discards it.

party.description: OID of the user or group the rule applies to.

type.description: Party type. Sisense also supports a 'default' catch-all rule for parties with no explicit rule; that is not created through this call — Sisense adds one automatically alongside the first rule on a column.

examples.user_query: Replace the data security rules on the 'Sales_Elasticube' datamodel: allow North America and Europe in the Orders table's Region column, and exclude Enterprise in the Customers table's CustomerType column.
examples.notes: This call replaces all existing datasecurity rules on the 'Sales_Elasticube' datamodel with the provided rules.

examples.notes: This call applies new datasecurity rules to the 'HR_Analytics' datamodel, ensuring sensitive columns like 'Salary' and 'SSN' are restricted.
